---
title: "Land_Use"
output: html_document
date: "2026-10-26"
---

```{r}
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
land_use <- st_read('./Land_Use_2020/PLAN_EXISTINGLANDUSE2020_A.shp')
```

```{r}
land_use_classes <- land_use %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(D_CLASS_CN) %>%
  summarise(class = n())
```

```{r}
land_use_desc <- land_use %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(CPD_LANDUS) %>%
  summarise(type = n())
```

```{r}
land_use_grouped <- land_use %>%
  mutate(LU_group = case_when(
    CPD_LANDUS %in% c('Single-unit Residential',
                      'single-unit residential',
                      'Two-unit Residential',
                      'Multi-unit Residential') ~ 'Residential',
    
    CPD_LANDUS %in% c('Commercial/Retail',
                      'Office') ~ 'Commercial_Office',
    
    CPD_LANDUS %in% c('Industrial',
                      'Trans/Comm/Utilities',
                      'ROW/Road') ~ 'Industrial_Transport',
    
    CPD_LANDUS == 'Mixed-use' ~ 'Mixed_Use',
    
    CPD_LANDUS %in% c('Entertainment/Cultural',
                      'Park/Open Space',
                      'Public/Quasi-public') ~ 'Public_Cultural_Rec',
    
    CPD_LANDUS == 'Parking' ~ 'Parking',
    
    CPD_LANDUS %in% c('Vacant',
                      'Agriculture') ~ "Vacant_Agriculture",
    
    TRUE ~ 'Other_Unknown'
  ))
```

```{r}
st_write(land_use_grouped, './Land_Use_2020/Land_Use_Grouped.shp')
```
